exposure: Multiple daily subcutaneous injections of regular insulin (RI)
outcome: Homeostasis model assessment of insulin resistance (HOMA-IR)
Lipid profile (Total cholesterol [TC], High-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol [LDL-C])
Maternal complications (Pregnancy-induced hypertension, Cesarean section, Polyhydramnios)
cohort: 98 patients diagnosed with Type A2 Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (A2GDM) admitted to Puer People's Hospital between March 2021 and September 2023.
finding: Insulin therapy via an insulin pump demonstrated superior efficacy in blood glucose control, improved glucose and lipid metabolism, required a lower insulin dose, and led to better maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to multiple daily subcutaneous injections for managing A2GDM.
mod_finding: The experimental group receiving insulin via an insulin pump had a lower rate of cesarean section.
